signature: SUBROUTINE ZLAESY( A, B, C, RT1, RT2, EVSCAL, CS1, SN1 )

params.name: b
params.reference: The ( 1, 2 ) element of input matrix. The ( 2, 1 ) element is also given by B, since the 2-by-2 matrix is symmetric.

params.name: evscal
params.reference: The complex value by which the eigenvector matrix was scaled to make it orthonormal. If `EVSCAL` is zero, the eigenvectors were not computed. This means one of two things: the 2-by-2 matrix could not be diagonalized, or the norm of the matrix of eigenvectors before scaling was larger than the threshold value THRESH (set below).

params.name: sn1
params.reference: If $\mathrm{EVSCAL} \ne 0$, ( `CS1`, `SN1` ) is the unit right eigenvector for `RT1`.
